entities.summary: Ukraine is a sovereign nation in Eastern Europe, Europe. Its capital is Kyiv (Kiev). Official languages include Ukrainian. Government: Unitary semi-presidential republic (martial law since Feb 24, 2022). Population: approximately 37.0 million. Area: 603,628 km². Comprehensive index for Ukraine covering Scythians, Kievan Rus' (9th-13th century, cradle of East Slavic civilization, Christianization 988), Mongol invasion 1240, Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, Cossack Hetmanate (Zaporizhian Sich), Russian Empire annexation, Holodomor 1932-33 (Stalin-engineered famine, 3.5-7.5M dead, genocide debate), WWII (Nazi occupation, Babi Yar massacre, OUN/UPA complex legacy, 8M dead), Chernobyl 1986, independence 1991, Orange Revolution 2004, Euromaidan 2014, Crimea annexation/Donbas war, Zelenskyy election 2019, Russian full-scale invasion Feb 24 2022 (ongoing).

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Ukraine's history is marked by significant regional impact, including its role in the Mongol invasion and WWII, with an estimated 8 million deaths during the latter. Its modern-day struggle for independence has real-world consequences.
